blocks.html:
Ford Mustang 2 Tone Stripes by Vinyl Wrap Toronto

“A good friend knows all your best stories, but a best friend has lived them with you”. Friendship is a beautiful bond between people. Friends are human beings who make tough times hurt less and make good times the best moments of our lives. If you’ve got friends who bring the best out of you, you have a lot to be grateful for. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we recently got to witness two friends who shared a similar interest in things. Too similar if you think about it. But hey! We were happy to see them doing things together and making milestones in their journey of friendship.

When you see friends doing matching things together, it is to show their appreciation for one another and the similar interests they share. Doing events with friends not only gets you what you want but also gives you a memory to cling to when you’re feeling low. A few days ago, we had two friends walk into our garage, asking to get stripes on their cars. When we enquired and took a look at the cars, we knew these gentlemen were really good friends. And they were not at all trying to hide it.

Both gentlemen had Ford Mustangs. One had a Black Mustang 2020 California Special and the other one had a Blue Mustang 2020. There’s no way it was a coincidence that they didn’t discuss car options before getting the Mustangs.

These Gentlemen wanted to get racing stripes on their Mustangs. They wanted to make a statement and we believe they had the right idea. Who wouldn’t notice two mustangs with similar Stripes? However, when they arrived, it was just an idea. These gentlemen were undecided on a lot of their options, such as the colour of stripes they wanted, material, design and ultimate finished look. Our team took it into their hands and offered their expert advice to help the clients to make a decision.

When you’ve been working in the industry for as long as our installers have, you develop a skill to figure out what the client would like. So, our installers talked to them and answered all their questions about the colours, finishes and materials. We showed them colour swatches to see what the finish and colour actually look like on the Mustangs.

The gentlemen greatly appreciated our team’s effort in helping them to make a decision. After their discussion with our team, the gentleman with the Blue Mustang made a decision to get Avery Dennison’s SW900 Matte Dark Grey coloured stripes. It was something he wouldn’t have originally gotten but after talking to our installers, he felt it was the right way to go.

The friend with the Black Mustang was a bit more specific about what he wanted. In the past, he had actually tried to install stripes by himself, but obviously, it didn’t go as well as he had hoped. While we appreciate a person who is self-reliant, there are some things that you should get done by experts.

Not only does it save you money, but it also gets you quality that you just can not get out of a ‘DIY’ job. So, after a failed attempt, he decided to get it done professionally. The client wanted 2 Tone Stripes. The inner Stripes are Avery Dennison’s Matte Metalic Charcoal and the outer stripes are Avery Dennison’s Matte Metalic Silver. A great choice indeed.

After helping them reach a decision and making sure what the clients want, our designers started to render the designs on digital mockups. We have a team of skillful designers who specialize in vehicle graphics, capable of rendering any design onto a vehicle layout as long as the client has given clear instructions. It didn’t take us long to get the digital mockups ready and show them to the customers. The clients liked what they saw and approved the mockups.

The next and the most sensitive step was to actually install the stripes on the cars. The Stripes go from the hood all the way to the back through the roof. It isn’t as easy as it may seem at first, an example being one of the clients trying to install the stripes by himself and not getting the desired results. Our installers took the stripes and installed them on both cars with the utmost care and precision.

The results were as expected by our team, spectacular. The two Mustangs certainly did make a statement after getting a touch of stripes. We’ve attached some pictures on this page for you to see. The clients were fully satisfied with the results and couldn’t wait to take their pride and joys out for a drive.

Adding Stripes to a vehicle is a great way to make it look a lot more personalized. It’s hard to miss a car that has some really cool stripes running down the center of the vehicle. Especially when the colour of the stripes complements the car’s colour. You could get stripes in any shape or size and anywhere on the car. All you have to do is decide that you want stripes and we’ll make it happen.

Read: Things to remember when getting stripes on your vehicle.

If you’ve decided to get stripes on your car or are just considering it, feel free to call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4. We would love to answer any questions you may have about your options.

To read more stories about vehicle wraps, please visit our blog page. Check out more car decals here.
